intelligence.enrichment: A plane mirror reflects multiple parallel rays as parallel rays, a concave mirror makes them converge, and a convex mirror makes them diverge. mirror surface shape determines whether reflected parallel rays stay parallel, converge, or diverge The learner predicts the reflected beam pattern for plane, concave, and convex mirrors from the mirror surface shape. All mirrors reflect parallel beams as parallel beams because each ray follows the law of reflection.
